requirements.text: The GenAI use case is registered in the AI Inventory and approved under AI-POL-001 §7.2 before any production use, including pilots with real customer or employee data.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (AI-STD-710 v1.0).

requirements.text: The use-case approval form describes purpose, users, affected persons, input data classifications, foundation model and provider, design, supported outputs, human-in-the-loop design, AI Act classification, AI Risk Class and evaluation plan.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (AI-STD-710 v1.0).

requirements.text: The approval defines the boundaries of intended use; an application supporting credit processes does not produce a credit decision, rating or approve/decline recommendation.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (AI-STD-710 v1.0).

requirements.text: The foundation model is identified by provider, model name and pinned version; auto-updating provider aliases are not used in production.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (AI-STD-710 v1.0).

requirements.text: System prompts, prompt templates, retrieval and guardrail configurations and generation parameters are version-controlled and released through change management.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (AI-STD-710 v1.0).

requirements.text: Changes to the foundation model version, system prompt or retrieval configuration are preceded by a regression evaluation on the golden set meeting the §8.3 thresholds.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (AI-STD-710 v1.0).

requirements.text: The system prompt states the role and task, permitted sources, output format, the instruction to answer only from supplied sources and to state when information is unavailable, and prohibited content.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (AI-STD-710 v1.0).

requirements.text: RAG knowledge sources are listed, owned and subject to data quality and access controls, and retrieval respects the access entitlements of the requesting user.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (AI-STD-710 v1.0).

requirements.text: The chunking, embedding, ranking approach and number of retrieved passages are documented, and retrieval recall of relevant passages is at least 90% on the retrieval test set.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (AI-STD-710 v1.0).

requirements.text: Outputs presenting facts from source documents include references to the source passages used.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (AI-STD-710 v1.0).

requirements.text: Personal data are included in prompts only where necessary for the approved purpose and covered by the DPIA.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies only where personal data can enter prompts or retrieval sources.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (AI-STD-710 v1.0).

requirements.text: An automated grounding check flags statements not supported by the source material before the output is shown to the user or reviewer.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (AI-STD-710 v1.0).

requirements.text: Every numeric value in an output is automatically compared with the source material, and numbers not matching a source value or documented calculation are flagged to the reviewer.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (AI-STD-710 v1.0).

requirements.text: Inputs and outputs are screened for personal data and confidential identifiers not permitted for the use case, with detections masked or blocked and logged.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (AI-STD-710 v1.0).

requirements.text: Inputs, including retrieved documents, are screened for prompt injection, and outputs for harmful, discriminatory or out-of-scope content.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (AI-STD-710 v1.0).

requirements.text: The application is evaluated before production on a versioned, SME-labelled golden set of at least 200 representative cases, including edge cases and cases requiring abstention.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (AI-STD-710 v1.0).

requirements.text: The evaluation measures groundedness, hallucination rate, numeric accuracy, completeness against reference and correct abstention rate.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (AI-STD-710 v1.0).

requirements.text: Groundedness is at least 95% for AI Risk Class High or Elevated and at least 90% for Standard.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (AI-STD-710 v1.0).

requirements.text: The hallucination rate does not exceed 2% for AI Risk Class High or Elevated and 5% for Standard.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (AI-STD-710 v1.0).

requirements.text: For AI Risk Class High or Elevated, 100% of numeric values are correct or flagged by the guardrail; for Standard, numeric accuracy is at least 98%.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (AI-STD-710 v1.0).

requirements.text: A model-as-judge evaluator is used only after calibration against human labels on at least 100 cases with at least 85% agreement, documented.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (AI-STD-710 v1.0).

requirements.text: Evaluations run at production generation parameters and report output variability across at least three repeated runs on a subset of the golden set.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (AI-STD-710 v1.0).

requirements.text: Applications of AI Risk Class Elevated or High are red-teamed before production, at least annually and after each foundation model version change, covering prompt injection, jailbreaking, data extraction, PII leakage, harmful content and out-of-scope use.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (AI-STD-710 v1.0).

requirements.text: Outputs used in business decisions or sent to customers are reviewed and approved by a competent person before use, unless automated release is explicitly approved with compensating guardrails.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (AI-STD-710 v1.0); AI Act cross-reference checked.

requirements.text: Effectiveness of human review is tested monthly by second-line quality review of at least 5% of approved outputs or 30 outputs, whichever is higher.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (AI-STD-710 v1.0).

requirements.text: GenAI content is labelled as AI-generated, with application name and generation date, in the document or interface in which it is used until approved by a human reviewer.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (AI-STD-710 v1.0); AI Act cross-reference checked.

requirements.text: Each interaction is logged with user identifier, timestamp, component versions, input, retrieved source identifiers, output, guardrail results and reviewer decision, retained for at least twelve months.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (AI-STD-710 v1.0); AI Act cross-reference checked.

requirements.text: Due diligence on the third-party foundation model covers provider documentation, data-use terms, data location, security certifications, sub-processors, incident notification and advance notice of model change or deprecation.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies only to foundation models or GenAI services sourced from a third party.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (AI-STD-710 v1.0); AI Act cross-reference checked.

requirements.text: The contract prohibits use of the Bank's inputs and outputs for training the provider's models without consent and requires notification of material model changes.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies only to foundation models or GenAI services sourced from a third party.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (AI-STD-710 v1.0).

requirements.text: The monitoring plan covers monthly groundedness and hallucination sampling of production outputs, guardrail trigger rates, reviewer edit and rejection rates, user feedback, availability and incidents.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (AI-STD-710 v1.0).
